newsitem.title: UK: European cotton market sees steady demand.
newsitem.headline: European cotton market sees steady demand.

text.p: The pattern of trading in raw cotton in European markets saw little change on Tuesday, according to traders.
Those mills with outstanding nearby shipment requirements, particularly for better grade descriptions, have been induced to seek additional quantities.
Quality concerns with regard to Central Asian supplies have been particularly in evidence and recent business in several markets has again focused on this origin.
West African styles have also encountered additional demand, traders said. --London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7771
